content: Node dns/promises resolveCname/resolve4 perform pure DNS resolution (no HTTP fetch), which is inherently SSRF-safer than fetching a resolved URL/IP — but resolving alone still doesn't protect against DNS-rebinding if the RESULT is later used to open a connection. For Kurzly's use case (compare resolved record string/IP against a fixed expected value, never connect to it), this is safe by construction as long as no subsequent HTTP request is made to the resolved address.
